review_focus: Full 16-Scenario coverage: each approved Scenario maps exactly once to a Design decision and exactly one AC without exceeding the upstream proposal-specs contract.

Typed root_qualification/resolved_edges/prerequisite_edges semantics, positive proofs for both implementation-prerequisite kinds, runtime-only non-dependency proof, shared-foundation single ownership, and explicit Batch dependencies.

Leaf Composable/preview/control/file non-root behavior, test_support obligation-only behavior, workflow-only user entry, production/test allowlists, and honest RED/GREEN or BASELINE PASS/RERUN lifecycle.

Structured capture-helper interface and fixed argv sequencing, missing-source/wrong-HEAD/wrong-remote/final-SHA TDD coverage, grouped Batch 3 RED/GREEN commands, File Changes ownership, and complete py_compile scope.

Banking, Ekspensify, and Buckwheat fixed URLs/revisions, complete real evidence subtrees, central content-bound Skill identity references, mandatory post-GREEN real runs, manifest membership/tamper verification, and historical evidence read-only ownership.
summary: Approved. The frozen Design/Tasks candidate preserves the complete 16-Scenario contract and closes the prior capture-command and compilation findings. The capture helper now accepts only structured inputs and owns fixed argv acquisition, checkout, verification, workflow capture, and freeze sequencing; its three behavior-changing cases are jointly RED/GREEN-gated and owned by test_orchestrator.py. The public-project evidence, identity, DAG, blocker, lifecycle, leaf/test-support, workflow-entry, portability, and batch boundaries are internally consistent and executable.
residual_risks: Dynamic navigation, dependency injection, and reflection-heavy relationships can remain unresolved by static analysis; the approved behavior is to emit explicit blockers rather than infer ownership or dependencies.

The three mandatory fixed-project freezes require network access or a prepared verified reuse cache and can be environment-intensive; they remain separate from portable default tests but mandatory for final evidence.
